repair: Correctness fix, applied before this attempt and not counted as the experimental factor: the trainer previously built AdamW directly on bf16 expert weights with bf16 optimizer state and no fp32 master copy; at lr 1e-5, updates below half-ULP rounded away, so 88.5% of the 96.6M expert weights and every RMSNorm gain could not move (attempt 1 changed 11.5% of bf16 weights -- the same share as the raster fine-tune, whose learning went through its fp32 vision tower -- and effectively trained ~3.3M fp32 parameters against a recorded 99,880,992). The trainer now casts trainable parameters to fp32 before the optimizer; checkpoints re-round to bf16 at evaluator load, so the deployed weights carry one final rounding of the accumulated delta. training.json now records wd/betas/eps/clip, the upcast count, and per-source (recovery vs anchor) interval-mean losses.
changed_factor: samples per optimizer step: effective batch 4 -> 32 by gradient accumulation of 8 micro-batches x 4 samples (2 recovery + 2 anchor each -- attempt 1's proven micro-batch, activation memory unchanged; loss divided by batch_size x grad_accum, backward per micro-batch, grad clip 1.0 applied once to the accumulated gradient, one AdamW step). Held at attempt 1's values: dataset recovery.npz (sha256 fefe32a8bf4b18310913ebd78c6a0aaa9f73281128056fa2b8f87def5feeca27, byte-untouched), init = untouched baseline, steps 300 (optimizer steps), lr 1e-5, AdamW torch defaults (wd 0.01, betas 0.9/0.999, eps 1e-8), seed 4242, rollout_fraction 0.5, unfreeze boundary, checkpoint_every 100, same anchor and retention sets, tolerance 1.10. Declared inseparable consequence at fixed steps: recovery draws 600 -> 4800 (~0.46 -> ~3.7 passes over 1310 labels) and anchor draws 600 -> 4800 (~4.7 -> ~37.5 passes over 128 frames). Declared attribution limit: with no attempt 3, a success is not attributable between the repair and the batch factor; partial attribution comes from the reloaded weight-diff check, the anchor_fit trajectory and the per-source losses.
evidence: analysis/offline-fit-a1.json and analysis/attempt2-review.json: the a1-step200 regression is confined to self-sample-aligned labels (+0.0042 branch, CI [+0.0004,+0.0075]; +0.0094 student; non-self H50 labels +0.00007) and fully present by step 100; weight audit: 11.5% of bf16 expert weights changed, 0% above |w|=5e-3, all RMSNorm gains unchanged; anchor-fit fell 0.133 -> 0.076-0.085 identically in all four prior fine-tunes. Screen H10 1/8 (mean conditions 2.375); baseline 2/8 (v2 run, 3.000) and 0/8 (v3 run, 2.500); H50 unchanged.
hypothesis: with the dtype defect repaired so the expert can move, and 16 supervised samples per optimizer step instead of 2, the policy moves measurably toward its validated recovery labels; if instead anchor_fit collapses ~40% again while retention breaches, anchor dominance is confirmed and anchor composition is the next campaign's single factor.
selection_rule: unchanged: driver.select_checkpoint default -- step_000300 if its retention guard passes, else step_000200 if it passes, else no candidate and attempt 2 concludes (interpreted as anchor-dominance evidence if anchor_fit also fell). The offline fit never selects among checkpoints.
precondition_offline_fit: after reload passes and before the screen, one job of scripts/offline_fit.py at its frozen hash on the same 80 branch + 80 student examples (default_rng(1234) over recovery.npz). PASS iff (a) on the RELOADED candidate, >= 50% of lm_expert bf16 weights differ from baseline and >= 1 RMSNorm gain changed (attempt 1 sat at 11.5% and 0), AND (b) over K=8 noise seeds per example, the paired (candidate - baseline) bootstrap 95% CI upper bound does not exceed the baseline's own mean seed-to-seed std, branch and student pooled. Reported only, never gated: per-label-class RMS splits, retention RMS, anchor_fit and retention trajectories, per-source train losses. Fail, or no result after one infrastructure retry: attempt 2 concludes and the screen is not run. In-sample; a necessary condition only; never evidence of improvement.
screen: unchanged: proceed only if H10 settled >= 4/8 on the 8 development H10 rows
confirmation_and_claim: unchanged manifest rules: a second H10 run and one H50 run; improvement rule (pooled 16 vs 16, margin >= 4, one-sided Fisher p < 0.05, H50 >= 4/8, retention guard, reload); untouched final set 8 + 8 only if the rule holds
